title: Product Page
description: A storefront product page: gallery, options, quantity, purchase actions and the accordions that answer the last questions.
usage: The gallery panels are gradient stand-ins — drop photographs into the same frames. Options are real form controls (swatches are radios, sizes the Segmented part), the quantity stepper is three buttons and a number, and the accordions are native details: the page needs no script until the cart does. Price, stock and shipping claims sit above the fold because that is where buying decisions happen.
a11y: Every option is a labeled native control; the rating is text as well as stars ("4.8, 212 reviews"); and the purchase button names the action it performs. Stock states must be announced in words, never by color alone.
